It is used by beginners through Major Championship winners on the PGA Tour, and has been validated by an Independent Scientific Study by the Departments of Physics and Biomechanics at Yale University. • Get real-time information about the state of the headlamp from a smart phone or tablet:
- battery charge level
- remaining burn time
- the headlamp profile currently active

• Five predefined profiles adapt performance to the activity: multi-activity, trail running, trekking, mountaineering and bivouac. Each profile has a choice of multiple lighting levels

• Create custom profiles:
- customize the headlamp to best suit the need

• LIVE mode:
- access control of the headlamp from your mobile device with Bluetooth®
- adjustment, in real time, of the brightness and burn time
- display of battery charge level

• Emergency light signal:
- if an alert needs to be sent, a brief message can be programmed into the smart phone and transformed into a Morse code light signal by the headlamp
- useful when there is no cell reception or other means of communication

Connected headlamps available from July 2016.
